blockingLoop.evidence: Turn 3 repeated turn 2 verbatim including 'If you can also let me know the brand and model number' after the customer had just given 'Indesit, label inside the door says IDV 75', but the customer still progressed.

rationale: The assistant correctly identified overheating from restricted airflow, led with filter and hose checks, got the crushed fluff-filled hose straightened and the dryer then ran past the cut-out point with no part sold - matching the hidden truth. Safety messaging (unplug first, fire risk, don't leave unattended) was appropriate. However it repeated an entire message verbatim and re-asked for the brand/model immediately after the customer supplied 'Indesit IDV 75', and it told the customer to check a condenser unit despite the opener stating the hose goes out the window, forcing the customer to correct it ('its a vented one'). Useful outcome, but sloppy attention to the customer's evidence.
